name: Robinhood
description: Robinhood lets agents read the accounts, positions, balances, transaction history and watchlists of a Robinhood customer, read market data, and place stock, options and crypto orders. Each user signs in to their own Robinhood account through the browser. At the first sign-in, Robinhood asks the user to open a separate Agentic account. Agents can trade only in that account, and by default they place orders without asking the user to approve each one.

prompts.text: Summarize my Robinhood positions and how they moved today.
How did each stock on my Robinhood watchlist move this week?
How much cash is in my Robinhood Agentic account?

apps.name: Robinhood
apps.description: Accounts, positions, market data and trades, over Robinhood's MCP server with browser sign-in.
